vehicle: Vast Haven-1, not Haven Demo or Haven-2
classification: Public-source reconstruction for an independent interview/engineering study; no released manufacturing CAD used

sources.title: Haven-1 official product and hardware progress
sources.supports: Envelope anchors and named/quantity-confirmed components; cold plates, thermal pump tray, fans, batteries, oxygen trays and MMOD shielding are publicly pictured.
sources.limits: No complete dimensioned hull/subsystem CAD, detailed mounting positions, wall thicknesses, full material/thermal-property dataset, or radiator area is supplied.

sources.title: Official media asset directory
sources.supports: Authoritative downloadable exterior and interior illustrations; preserve Vast credit and any existing watermark.

sources.title: Haven-1 interior cutaway, July 2026
sources.supports: Axial docking entrance, corridor/crew-quarter region, common area and lab opposite docking, and radial domed window near common-area end. Four solar-bank planforms are visible.
sources.limits: Perspective artwork, not dimensioned engineering drawing; internal equipment behind interior liners is not disclosed.

sources.title: Haven-1 wide exterior illustration
sources.supports: Cylindrical barrel with tapered ends; narrow axial docking neck and dark opposite-end taper; solar-array planform.
sources.limits: Perspective and rendering do not establish section lengths, exact shroud thickness or active thermal radiator identity.

sources.title: Haven-1 current product hero
sources.supports: Current exterior silhouette including tapered dark end opposite docking and two solar-bank areas per side.
sources.limits: Small station within orbital render; insufficient to derive fine dimensional tolerances.

sources.title: Haven-1 docking exterior illustration
sources.supports: Docking neck at axial end of a tapered transition; exterior interface, side hull panels and solar-array relation.
sources.limits: Dragon is a separate spacecraft; do not count its nose hatch or body in Haven-1 geometry.

sources.title: Final Haven-1 interior design announcement
sources.supports: Four private crew quarters, corridor, common area, 1.1m window, lab and deployable table.
sources.limits: Historical launch dates in article are superseded; illustrations cannot define hidden systems.

sources.title: Haven-1 integration phase
sources.supports: Thermal-control, life-support and propulsion fluid systems; avionics/GNC/air revitalization; later exterior radiators, MMOD protection and solar arrays.
sources.limits: Subsystem existence and integration sequence do not establish their undisclosed spatial layout.

sources.title: Systems and methods for docking and undocking a spacecraft
sources.supports: A real Vast-assigned patent concerning docking/undocking with spinning spacecraft and control/sensing concepts.
sources.limits: Not a dimensioned Haven-1 hull or manufacturing drawing; does not prove Haven-1 uses each illustrated mechanism. Listed legal status/assignee are not independently adjudicated here.

sources.title: ECLSS Trace Contaminant Control Testing
sources.source_type: public technical paper by Vast/NASA authors, NASA NTRS
sources.supports: Public basis for Air Revitalization System / trace-contaminant-control submodel and ground test approach.
sources.limits: Not a complete flight ECLSS geometry/thermal specification and not validation of this independent CAD model.

cad_assumptions.assumption: Coordinate system: X=0 docking tip; longitudinal +X points toward opposite tapered end. Window on radial +Z side near common area.
cad_assumptions.basis: Consistent review convention and visual interpretation of V03/V04.

cad_assumptions.assumption: Envelope length 10.1m, maximum diameter4.4m; docking-end transition X=0–2.0m, barrel X=2.0–8.3m, opposite-end taper X=8.3–10.1m.
cad_assumptions.basis: Only overall dimensions sourced; individual section lengths are inferred for initial reconstruction.

cad_assumptions.assumption: Twelve solar-wing assemblies visually grouped into four planform banks, three wings per bank; mirrored side pairs.
cad_assumptions.basis: Quantity12 sourced; grouping, hinges, cell segmentation, standoff, individual span and thickness are inferred.

cad_assumptions.assumption: Radial window centered approximately X=8.2m; diameter1.1m.
cad_assumptions.basis: Diameter sourced; X position, protrusion and curvature inferred from illustration.

cad_assumptions.assumption: Represent radiator as a named candidate surface or separate illustrative panel.
cad_assumptions.basis: Radiator existence sourced, but exact active external faces, area, coating and plumbing are not publicly established in reviewed material.

cad_assumptions.assumption: Preserve distinction between gross exterior envelope, nominal pressurized80m3, and habitable45m3.
cad_assumptions.basis: Public volumes do not dimension the pressure shell. A 4.4m outer envelope must not be claimed as a verified inner pressure-vessel diameter.

cad_assumptions.assumption: Hidden avionics, battery, thermal-loop, propulsion, ECLSS envelopes and mounting/routing are representative placeholders unless separately supported.
cad_assumptions.basis: No complete flight layout/BOM released in reviewed sources.

next_stage_boundary: CAD review only. No meshing, CFD, thermal mission prediction, strength qualification or physical validation claimed.
